title: Count Non Adjacent Subsets in a Rooted Tree
summary: A tree rooted at zero has parent[i]<i and positive node values. Count nonempty selected-node subsets with sum divisible by k and no parent-child pair both selected. Return the count modulo 1000000007.
officialConstraints: 1..1000 nodes; parent[0]=-1; other parents valid and smaller than child index; values 1..10^9; k 1..100.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
